sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Tufail Hasan Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arvind Kumar Mishra-I,J.
Hon'ble Subhash Chand,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record of this writ petition.

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the first information report dated 15.12.2018 in Case Crime No.
225 of 2018, under Section - 31 Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 and under Section - 272 I.P.C.,
Police Station - Eka, District - Firozabad.
Upon consideration of the averments contained in the accompanying affidavit and various aspects of the case as well as the petitioner's submission

, it cannot be said that prima facie, no case is made out Jogendra @ Yogesh vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 12 October, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109714202/
1 against the petitioner as the F.I.R. in question does discloses a cognizable offence, in view of this,
there is no occasion for this Court to quash the F.I.R., as has been prayed on behalf of petitioner, as such, prayer made on the said score is refused by this Court.

entities.text: Jogendra @ Yogesh vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Consequently, the instant petition is dismissed.
It is made clear that the observation made in this order shall not be construed to have any reflection on merits of the case.
